## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a reproduction or issue when useful.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their outcomes; distinguish host tests,
QEMU evidence and physical-machine acceptance. Include source/payload identity
for hardware work. State any untested behavior or retained failure evidence.

## Documentation and limits

Note updated guides, ABI/driver/profile changes, dependencies or recovery concerns.
For screenshots, include the capture method and source identity. Keep private
captures and credentials out of the patch.
